The Office of the Assistant Director, Skill Development Department, vide Letter No. 150/Skill Dev./CSSDA/2026-27, Dhamtari, dated 17.07.2026, has issued directions to the Regional Manager, Madhurima Training Institute, Village Koliyari, based on the inspection of the training programmes being conducted at the institute.

The institute has been directed to immediately ensure compliance with the following instructions:

Increase the training capacity of the institute from the existing level to 80–150 trainees.
Increase the number of trainers in proportion to the enhanced training capacity.
Formulate an effective plan for providing employment and placement opportunities to youth and women after completion of the training.

The institute has further been directed to submit a compliance report in this regard within 03 days.
